name: Iori
message: 「Right, time to head home. Today was a productive day...」
After finishing some errands along the way, I hurried home.
The sun was beginning to set—and it was then.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, Teacher！ Wait, wait！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu？」
Suddenly, Ririmu came over, waving her hand to stop me.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s the matter？ I thought you’d already gone home.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「About that. I was waiting to ambush you, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why would you do something like that...？ If you needed something, you could have just messaged me, and I would have come to you.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah... I guess I just felt like it had to be me doing the approaching this time.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean by that？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, you know. Uh... I’m sorry about today！」
With that, Ririmu bowed her head.

name: Iori
message: 「Eh, wh-what！？ What happened？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, you know... with the Technical Division kids, and Asahi, and all that stuff, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I felt like I’d caused you a lot of trouble, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, is that what this is about?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, don’t get me wrong, I don’t think it was all my fault, okay？ I have my own way of thinking too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But, well... I actually kinda knew that what you were saying was right, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I guess I just couldn’t be honest, or something like that... so, sorry！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, there’s no need to apologize. I’m not angry at all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「For real？ You’re really not mad？ Even though you warned me over and over, I...」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn’t be a teacher if I got angry over something like that. As long as you understand and we’ve cleared the air, that’s all that matters.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, I don’t think what you said was wrong either, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh... ehehe, I’m glad to hear that.」
Seemingly relieved by my words, Ririmu smiled shyly.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, that’s right！ I made sure to apologize to the kid from the Technical Division, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And I handed over my Origami, and they said they’d do as much as they could！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, that’s great！ I’m sure they’ll do their best. It’s also very admirable that you were able to apologize properly, Ririmu！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Though, they said it’ll probably break if they try to force it near the limit. That’s why they’re going to try coating it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s amazing, you know？ They said it was just approved using the latest method. Doesn’t the word ‘latest’ sound so cool？」

name: Iori
message: 「The latest... <d0072>Monomolecular Coating</d>, huh. So it’s been completed. If I recall correctly, it’s supposed to be effective, albeit temporarily.」
Still, it’s a time-consuming technique that requires application before every match. I can feel the heart and ambition of that kid in the Technical Division.

name: Iori
message: 「If you can improve each other, that’s all that matters.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’ve also been doing some reflecting, I guess you could say. Thanks to you, Teacher, I think I was able to realize a lot of things.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So... thank you, Teacher.」
Though she averted her eyes slightly, Ririmu thanked me and smiled shyly.
Seeing that, I start to feel happy too.

name: Iori
message: 「I didn’t do anything to be thanked for, but if it helped you grow even a little, Ririmu, then I’m glad.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But really, I said a lot of awful things. I feel so down whenever I think back on it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I might be feeling pretty down for a while...」

name: Iori
message: 「Would you like me to keep you company？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Keep me company... what do you mean？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you’re feeling down, I thought maybe we could enjoy doing something that’ll cheer you up together.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, we have class tomorrow, so there’s a limit to how long we can stay out.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「For real！？ You’ll keep me company, Teacher！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I’ll go along with anything.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then let’s go, let’s go, let’s go right now！ Let’s go have some fun！ Hurry, hurry, let’s not waste any time！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you sure change your mood quickly, Ririmu.」
As she said that, Ririmu pulled my sleeve and started running.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, look here, look at this place！」

name: Iori
message: 「This is... clothing... no, a boutique for girls?」
Stepping into the shop, it’s an explosion of color. Clothes of every hue are beautifully displayed.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Found ya! Manager! I'm here♪」

name: Manager
message: 「Oh, my, my, my, Lily-chan♪ Welcome, I’m so glad you could make it～♪」
It’s just like the Manager to be hugging Ririmu in delight. She’s a broad-shouldered, <d0073>muscular lady</d>.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sorry I'm late, Manager. And congrats on the shop opening～♪」

name: Manager
message: 「Oh, don't you worry about that at all♪ Thank you, Lily-chan.」

name: Manager
message: 「But more importantly... I can't believe Lily brought a boyfriend！？ And he’s actually a normal, decent guy. What’s going on？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Too baaad, he’s not my boyfriend. He’s the Sensei who’s teaching me Jindou!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hello. We’ve come here as things have panned out.」

name: Manager
message: 「Oh my, oh my, oh my! Is that so!」

name: Manager
message: 「Wait, a teacher！？ This girl is close with a teacher！？ No way... I can't believe it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-heh-hem, your info is outdated, Manager! I’m a serious, diligent student now, you know!」

name: Manager
message: 「G-goodness, how times have changed...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Anyway, Manager, show me your prized clothes！」

name: Manager
message: 「Yes, of course, take your time～♪」
As she said that, Ririmu started browsing here and there. She really is a bundle of raw action.

name: Manager
message: 「Ufufu, Lily-chan is a bit eccentric, isn't she？ But at her core, she's a very good girl.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, I know. She's a wonderful girl.」
From what I heard, she and the Manager met while Ririmu was running away from home.
Back then, she was selling vintage clothes on the street, but after many turns of events, she finally managed to open her dream shop.

name: Manager
message: 「Back then, Ririmu was really edgy. All the playboys around here were Ririmu's lackeys.」

name: Manager
message: 「If she gave the word, it would spark a feud that would put real gangs to shame.」

name: Manager
message: 「Compared to those days, she’s really mellowed out, hasn't she～」

name: Iori
message: 「Ha, ha-ha-ha... That’s incredible...」
What the... Ririmu’s past is way too unsettling. I’m just going to pretend I didn’t hear that...

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, come to think of it, where did Ririmu go？ I don't see her—」

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is amazing！？ It’s super stylish. And this one... wait, they used ruffles here！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s literally a dream world~♪ Also, this and this and... ugh, there are just too many coordinate materials, I can't decide！」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure about that...」

name: Manager
message: 「Lily-chan has <d0096>impeccable</d> taste, you know♪ Much better than mine.」

name: Manager
message: 「So just sit back and watch, okay？ Ufufufu.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, is that so.」
According to the manager, Ririmu’s sense of coordination is outstanding. However, it seems she only pursues what fits her own worldview.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu has the soul of a professional even here, I see.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alrighty！ Manager, lend me the fitting room！」

name: Manager
message: 「Take your time♪ Here, it’s going to be a while, so have a seat.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thank you very much.」
She brought a mountain of clothes into the fitting room and is rummaging around. She must be trying them on to compare.

name: Iori
message: 「This is definitely going to take a while—」
Or so I thought.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey~ Iorin, you got a second！？」
At that shout—the fitting room curtain flew open！

name: Iori
message: 「W-Whoa！? Ririmu, what are you wearing...！?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin, this and this！ Which one do you think suits me better？」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh, no, don't ask me... I mean, more importantly, put something on quickly...！」
Ririmu shows off the clothes she picked out while still in her underwear.
She seems to be choosing clothes with the utmost seriousness, but... I don't know where to look！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Listen, this one is pretty 'me,' right？ A bit devilish, and the color scheme is amazing！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But like~ it feels like it lacks that girlish touch, you know？ I want more of a girly accent~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm~ oh, I know！ What if I add a scarf? If I do, then the color... maybe orange? Ugh, I can't decide.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And look at this shirt！ It’s amazing！ The pattern changes depending on the angle you look at it from！ This must be a new material~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How do they even do the pattern... look, isn't it crazy how it changes every time you look？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s new and trendy, but the color isn't quite my thing. It needs more of a, how do I put it... ugh, this is hard！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey Iorin, are you even paying attention~？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, I am looking, but... is it really okay for me to be looking...？」
Being this close, there’s no way I couldn't see. Everything from the swell of her chest to the line of her waist is perfectly in view.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, geez, I can’t discard either of them！ Think, me... there has to be some kind of, like, snap-worthy combination！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Right, there’s no point in choosing just one！ Uh, looking at what I had before... maybe like this？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes！ Look, look, isn’t this just perfect！？ It’s a super edgy design, but isn’t it just naturally good？」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh？ Uh... ah, yeah, I think it’s really good.」

name: Iori
message: 「The individual pieces are all different, but they match up really well. It really doesn’t feel out of place at all.」
...But isn't it opened up a bit too much at the chest?

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right~?! Iorin, you really get it! And to think you chose this, as expected of the Manager~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, bring me that one over there. Which one is the base... yeah, those shorts are good！」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh, which one is ‘that one over there’！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Over there, over there！ You should be able to feel it！」
As I stand there confused, the Manager hands me the clothes she was talking about. Do they think I’m some kind of assistant?

name: Iori
message: 「You keep coming up with one idea after another, but maybe it’s time to actually... you know, wear them？」

name: Manager
message: 「Ufufufu. It’s no use, Sensei, she won’t listen to a word. When Lily-chan gets like that, she’s just like a model.」

name: Iori
message: 「A model... you say?」
I ask while balancing the clothes shoved into my arms.

name: Manager
message: 「Yes, a professional model. During a fashion show, they come out changing outfits one after another, don't they？」

name: Iori
message: 「Those are all pretty eccentric fashions, though.」

name: Manager
message: 「Well, you see, models change clothes stark naked in front of tons of staff members backstage.」

name: Manager
message: 「Since changing and fittings are a matter of seconds, after all. That’s why models don’t mind at all if they’re seen naked.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so Ririmu is in that state of mind right now...」
Ririmu's sense and focus are amazing even in Jindou. But perhaps even more so when it comes to fashion.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Look! Yes! It came, it came! Iorin, Iorin, isn’t this combination super good too？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「New fashion born！ It really feels like a Flying Lily, doesn’t it?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is definitely the one! Manager, we’re going with this set for today!」

name: Manager
message: 「Oh my, so many？ Thank you~♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I knew your sense was amazing, Manager. I can always count on finding great stuff here~」

name: Manager
message: 「Hehe, you’re the one who’s a natural with style. Oh, would you mind if I used these for a display？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Of course! Go ahead and decorate to your heart’s content~」

name: Manager
message: 「Hehe, why not just come work here after you graduate？ I’d love to leave all the coordinating to you, Lily-chan.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sooo sorry, but I’m planning on launching my own brand, you know~♪」
Seemingly satisfied at last, she hands over the clothes.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, lend me that thing from before~」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, sure... wait, what’s wrong？」
Just then, Ririmu’s hands suddenly stop moving.

name: Ririmu
message: 「H-huh...？ Sensei is there, and I’m here... and I’m currently in my underwear...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaaah！？ W-w-why are you looking, Sensei！？」

name: Iori
message: 「I-it’s a bit late to bring that up now, don't you think！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, don't look so much！ Even if it’s you, Sensei, it’s still embarrassing, you know~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Attacking your student is against the rules, right！？ That kind of thing is off-limits until I give the go-ahead！」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I have no idea what you’re talking about！？ Just put your clothes on！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I will！ I’m gonna wear something super cute！ The only time I’d ever be caught without clothes is ‘those times,’ anyway！」

name: Manager
message: 「Fufu. I’m relieved to see you two get along so well.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't just stand there feeling all warm and fuzzy, help me out！」

name: Manager
message: 「Yes, yes. There now, Lily-chan, calm down. Let’s just head back to the fitting room.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uuu, he saw... Sensei saw everything~」
Calmed slightly by the manager’s words, Ririmu heads back into the fitting room.
However, even after she went inside, her embarrassed voice could be heard for a while.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nom, munch munch... nnh~！ The crepes at this shop really are delicious~♪」
We left the boutique—and to get her back in a good mood, we ended up touring a few sweets shops.
Since every one of them was recommended by Ririmu, they were indeed delicious.

name: Iori
message: 「Have you cheered up even a little bit？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fixed it, fixed it. I totally forgive you！ I'm in such a good mood I could forgive any villain in the world right now～」

name: Iori
message: 「Is it really that big of a deal?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eating sweets just makes you happy, doesn't it? Oh, let's head to that shop next! Their eclairs look super Instagrammable～」

name: Iori
message: 「A-aren't you eating a bit too much？ This is the fifth shop already.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. I'll just burn it off by moving around later!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Instead of holding back on what you love just to stay lazy, isn't it better to work hard so you can do what you love？」

name: Iori
message: 「You're right... I suppose that's true.」
That, too, was truly like Ririmu, and it wasn't a bad thing.

name: Ririmu
message: 「So with that said, let's keep going full steam ahead！ I'm pretty sure that place over there has those mega-sized sweets that look great in photos too～♪」
Ririmu truly gives her all for the things she loves.
As I chased after the free―spirited Ririmu―I felt myself naturally starting to have fun as well.
